{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check how many duplicate patient_ids there are
n_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()

# Check how many patients were re-tested (i.e., how many have >1 row)
df_counts = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
n_retested = (df_counts > 1).sum()

print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {n_duplicates}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows (re-tested): {n_retested}")"}
